# Gmail fixtures: provenance and limits

These ten HTML files and their `*.expected.json` are **not captured from a real
Gmail account**. Agents building Readback have no Gmail login, so the markup is
hand-built from Gmail's publicly observable DOM conventions and generated by
`generate.mjs` (run `node tests/fixtures/gmail/generate.mjs` to rebuild).

What the markup imitates: `[data-message-id]` message wrappers, `div.a3s.aiL`
bodies, `.gmail_quote` and `.gmail_signature` blocks, `span.gD[email][name]`
senders, `span.g3[title]` absolute timestamps, `[email]` recipient chips, a
`g_editable` contenteditable textbox, `input[name="subjectbox"]`, an
`input[name="from"]`, `div[role="dialog"]` pop-out composes and a
`div[role="main"]` thread view.

What it cannot tell us: whether those selectors match **today's** Gmail. Gmail
changes class names without notice, so every selector in
`src/adapters/gmail/selectors.ts` is a fallback chain, and the self-test makes
the adapter go silent when the chain fails. **Live-Gmail behaviour is
unverified** until a human captures sanitised real snapshots (HANDOFF.md).

All people, addresses, companies and amounts are invented
(`sam.ortiz@example.com`, `Kathryn Moss`, `Larchmont Lettings`).

| Fixture                     | Case                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `inline-reply`              | Inline reply under the open conversation; the user's own signature sits in the editor                                                                 |
| `popout-reply`              | Pop-out compose (`role="dialog"`), `Re:` subject, To and Cc chips                                                                                     |
| `forward`                   | Inline forward, `Fwd:` subject                                                                                                                        |
| `theme-light`, `theme-dark` | Same thread, editor background white or dark grey; the adapter reads the host theme from the computed background                                      |
| `quoted-history`            | Three messages; the latest carries a `.gmail_quote` with decoy names and amounts that must not be read; one earlier message is the user's own ("me")  |
| `long-signature`            | A six-line corporate signature with phone numbers and a legal footer                                                                                  |
| `own-last`                  | The user's own message is last; the adapter must read the one before it                                                                               |
| `renamed-classes`           | A simulated layout change: classes, message attributes, `role="main"` and `email` attributes renamed. The self-test must fail and nothing may be read |
| `new-message`               | A brand-new compose (no `Re:`, not in the thread): not a reply, not an error                                                                          |
